description: This Java abstract class, AbstractMessageSenderConnectionEventProducer, implements connection event notification logic for devices, utilizing a DownstreamSender for sending connection/disconnection events with context-specific data.

classes.name: AbstractMessageSenderConnectionEventProducer
classes.description: An abstract class responsible for sending connection-related events via a downstream sender, to devices identified by their tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: connected
methods.description: Handles the 'connected' event by sending a notification using the downstream sender.

methods.name: disconnected
methods.description: Handles the 'disconnected' event by sending a notification using the downstream sender.

methods.name: sendNotificationEvent
methods.description: Constructs and sends a notification event with cause ('connected' or 'disconnected') and additional data.

methods.name: getOrCreateSender
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a DownstreamSender for a specified tenant using the sender factory.
